svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Languages, frontend, backend and data, cloud and DevOps, AI and APIs, tooling: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, GNU Bash, HTML5, CSS, React, Vue.js, Svelte, Astro, Next.js, Nuxt, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, TanStack, Vite, Bun, Node.js, Hono, Express, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, Redis, MongoDB, SQLite, Cloudflare, Cloudflare Workers, Docker, Coolify, Linux, Ubuntu, Oracle Cloud, Hetzner, Vercel, GitHub Actions, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Claude, Stripe, WhatsApp, Meta, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Google Search Console, Brevo, Git, GitHub, Biome, Vitest, Playwright, Turborepo, Excalidraw.
